counting_formula: For each method/group, denominator = selected scheduled windows; candidate + candidate_absent + unavailable = denominator. Invalid pairing, missing, parse failure, insufficient input and indeterminate without candidate are unavailable. Candidate with indeterminate remains candidate. No merged event is read.

exclusions.cost: not measured by this evaluator; reused generation is not a speed improvement
exclusions.fallback: four C4 cases excluded from ROI comparative performance; four C records reuse B
exclusions.official_annotation: manifest reference only; no official label file read
exclusions.partial_positive: d030_90 presence only, diagnostic; no person count, onset or completion score
exclusions.target_boundary: alignment unverified; off-ROI success/negative never inferred
exclusions.unknown_labels: excluded from behavioral scores, retained in output counts

execution_scope: CPU cached text/metadata only; no media decoding or inference

selection_timing: Retrospective after completed inference and prior public aggregate report; the twelve itemized per-window B/C result.json files were not consulted during selection. This is outcome-aware development material, not a prospective or independent test.
